_what: Citation artifact for the news-feed predicate in scripts/verify/verify-cryptorank.py. One upstream capture per arm of the check.
check: news: titles intact + every real URL is http
why_the_old_predicate_was_retired: The retired predicate asserted every newsRows[i].url is a non-empty string. Upstream's feed carries a PINNED PROMO slot whose row is not a publisher article: its date is null and its url may be null (client.ts CrNewsRow: 'null upstream = pinned promo slot -> em-dash'). Asserting a URL on every row therefore tested upstream's CMS, not our shaping, and hard-failed on a legitimate spacer row. The honest invariant kept in the harness: titles always intact; every REAL url is non-empty http; a null url only on a pinned promo slot (date also null).
